title: Shellstone Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Our family stayed at Shellstone Cottage and we had a very comfortable and enjoyable stay. The patios are both very large with incredible views of the beach. The walk to the beach was short and easy, especially with little ones. What sets Shellstone Cottage apart from other houses we’ve stayed in is the decor and furniture. They went above and beyond on the quality of furniture, bedding and decor from the patios to the living spaces and bedrooms. The house was very clean. The service was also top notch. The pool was heated upon our arrival. After experiencing a minor glitch with internet, the property manager came over and fixed it immediately. As far as location, it’s a short bike ride to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Very quiet neighbors - highly recommend! Poised directly on the sugar-white sands of Seacrest Beach, this stunning Gulf-front residence offers an elevated coastal experience with panoramic water views, private beach access, and a sparkling private pool. Spanning three thoughtfully designed levels, the home comfortably sleeps 12 and features four spacious bedrooms—each with its own en-suite bathroom. The open-concept second floor is the heart of the home, where a breezy living space, gourmet kitchen, and dining area all enjoy breathtaking views of the emerald coast. Sliding doors open to a beachfront balcony perfect for al fresco dining or sunset lounging, making every moment indoors feel seamlessly connected to the natural beauty outside.
